mapper.sql: select p.pool_id, p.pool_no, p.pool_name, p.tenant_id, p.total_invest_amount, p.total_return_amount, p.break_even_gap, p.over_return_amount, p.break_even_time, p.confirmed_time, p.confirmed_by, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from fin_composite_accounting_pool p
mapper.update:
update fin_composite_accounting_pool
pool_name=#{poolName}, total_invest_amount=#{totalInvestAmount}, total_return_amount=#{totalReturnAmount}, break_even_gap=#{breakEvenGap}, over_return_amount=#{overReturnAmount}, break_even_time=#{breakEvenTime}, confirmed_time=#{confirmedTime}, confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark},
where pool_id=#{poolId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status in ('0','1','2') and p.pool_id = ( select max(d.pool_id) from fin_composite_pool_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.status = '0' )
mapper.update: update fin_composite_accounting_pool set total_return_amount = total_return_amount + #{amount}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select id, pool_id, dept_id, dept_name, join_time, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from fin_composite_pool_dept where pool_id = #{poolId} and del_flag = '0' order by join_time asc
select dept_id from fin_composite_pool_dept where pool_id = #{poolId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select dept_id from sys_user_dept where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
select dept_name from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from fin_composite_pool_dept where pool_id = #{poolId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.select: select id, pool_id, investor_id, investor_name, invest_amount, invest_ratio, returned_amount, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from fin_composite_pool_investor where pool_id = #{poolId} and del_flag = '0' order by id asc
mapper.update: update fin_composite_pool_investor set returned_amount = #{returnedAmount}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.pool_id, i.dept_id, d.dept_name, i.period_id, i.period_no, p.start_time as period_start_time, p.end_time as period_end_time, i.net_profit, i.manager_profit_amount, i.investor_profit_amount, i.included_mode, i.included_time, i.included_by, i.status, i.del_flag, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark from fin_composite_period_item i left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.dept_id left join fin_accounting_period p on p.period_id = i.period_id and p.del_flag = '0' where i.pool_id = #{poolId} and i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0' order by i.included_time desc

select coalesce(sum(p.total_verified_expense), 0) as totalVerifiedExpense, coalesce(sum(p.total_purchase), 0) as totalPurchase, coalesce(sum(p.total_sale_amount), 0) as totalSaleAmount, coalesce(sum(p.total_sale_payment), 0) as totalSalePayment, coalesce(sum(p.total_unverified_advance), 0) as totalUnverifiedAdvance from fin_composite_period_item i join fin_accounting_period p on p.period_id = i.period_id and p.del_flag = '0' where i.pool_id = #{poolId} and i.del_flag = '0' and i.status = '0'

select item_id, pool_id, dept_id, period_id, period_no, net_profit, manager_profit_amount, investor_profit_amount, included_mode, included_time, included_by, status, del_flag from fin_composite_period_item where pool_id = #{poolId} and period_id = #{periodId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select item_id, pool_id, dept_id, period_id, period_no, net_profit, manager_profit_amount, investor_profit_amount, included_mode, included_time, included_by, status, del_flag from fin_composite_period_item where period_id = #{periodId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update fin_composite_period_item set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId} and period_id = #{periodId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
